title: Our Future Health — Linked health records data — Cancer treatment events
description: Array of Our Future Health linked health records. One element is one treatment event at one tumour, from 1 January 1995.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce that ROW_ID is unique across rows, or that every PID exists in the participant table (D102). A value absent in the source is -998 (the string "-998" for text, dates and coded strings), D101; a text or date column accepts any string, so no format is asserted for it (D043).
